_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 52 windows showing ±2-point score movement and 0-for-18 on forced directional calls, HOLD is the graded, statistically honest call — not a punt but the correct read of a market that refuses to resolve.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst reluctantly tilts UP to Anxiety only if ETF flows turn positive; narrative writer implies UP is already in motion via accumulation. The analyst's breaker condition (ETF flows > 15) has not been met, so the analyst's effective call is HOLD while the narrative's is implicitly LONG.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive above 15 AND BTC holds above $63k for 48h with funding staying positive — this converts the coil into a legitimate UP leg and shifts phase to Anxiety
